schemaDescription: Join Myntmore as an HR and Operations Intern in BKC, Mumbai. Build real hiring pipelines, KPI/KRA frameworks, and HR systems directly with the founder. Work from office.
aboutIntro: We're looking for a proactive, highly organised, and detail-obsessed HR & Operations Intern who wants to understand how a high-growth services business actually operates from the inside. This is not a traditional HR internship where you file papers and send templated rejection emails. You'll work directly with the founder and leadership team across talent acquisition, operational systems, performance frameworks, team coordination, and culture building. If you want to understand how companies hire, scale, build accountability, and operate efficiently, this role will give you a ring-side seat and real responsibility from week one.

responsibilities.title: Talent Acquisition & Hiring Support
responsibilities.desc: Manage active hiring pipelines across multiple roles. Source candidates via LinkedIn, job boards, and referrals. Screen applications, coordinate interviews, track candidate status, and draft job descriptions.

responsibilities.title: KPI & KRA Framework Building
responsibilities.desc: Help design and document KPIs and KRAs for different roles at Myntmore. Work with the founder and team leads to define what 'great performance' looks like per function, and build simple tracking systems for accountability.

responsibilities.title: Employee Onboarding & Documentation
responsibilities.desc: Design and run a smooth onboarding experience for new team members. Maintain offer letters, NDAs, contracts, and internal policies. Create role-specific onboarding checklists so new hires get up to speed fast.

responsibilities.title: Operational Systems & Documentation
responsibilities.desc: Build and maintain internal SOPs across operations, hiring, and team workflows. Keep company Notion workspaces, drive folders, and trackers organised and up to date.

responsibilities.title: Attendance, Leaves & Payroll Support
responsibilities.desc: Track team attendance, leaves, and working days. Support in monthly payroll calculations, expense reimbursements, and invoice tracking for contractors and team members.

responsibilities.title: Team Culture & Internal Communications
responsibilities.desc: Help organise team catch-ups, milestone celebrations, and internal reviews. Foster an environment of high ownership, fast feedback, and transparent communication across the team.

whoYouAre.label: Detail-Oriented
whoYouAre.desc: You don't miss small details. Names, numbers, dates, documents: accuracy matters to you

whoYouAre.label: Systems Thinker
whoYouAre.desc: You naturally organise things: spreadsheets, folders, Notion pages, and checklists

whoYouAre.label: Strong Communicator
whoYouAre.desc: Clear, professional, and empathetic in both written and spoken communication

whoYouAre.label: Discreet & Trustworthy
whoYouAre.desc: You can handle sensitive information (salaries, performance reviews, hiring decisions) with absolute confidentiality

whoYouAre.label: Proactive
whoYouAre.desc: You don't wait to be told what to do; you see a gap and take initiative

whoYouAre.label: Curious About Business
whoYouAre.desc: You want to understand how a company runs, how revenue connects to team size, and what makes a high-performance culture

whatYoullLearn: How to build end-to-end recruitment pipelines for a fast-growing agency
How to design real KPI/KRA frameworks that tie directly to business outcomes
How to create operational SOPs and systems that allow a team to scale smoothly
How founders make hiring, compensation, and organizational decisions
Hands-on experience with modern tools: Notion, Google Workspace, LinkedIn Recruiter/Sales Nav, and HR tracking systems
whyJoin: Work directly with the leadership team from day one. You'll sit at the intersection of people, operations, and growth: learning how a modern, AI-first agency is built and run. Work from our BKC office in Mumbai with a young, ambitious team, with high potential for a full-time role based on performance.
